_doc: The one timeline (EXAMPLE content: a Tidewell story). film.js reads scene windows and named cues from here (cue times are seconds from the scene start); captions render from here; the .srt, the SFX mix, the copy check, the review tools and the README all read it. Retime a scene and its cues, SFX and captions move together. voice and music are empty tracks for a later pass: add {start, file, gain} items and mix.py mixes them; read music hit points off the cues.

summary: A silent-first product film: a cut-paper cast carries the story over real product UI.

brand._doc: BRAND: one block for the whole film (kit, engine, captions, end card, chart background, review page). Replace these with your product's tokens (DESIGN.md, tokens.css, a Tailwind config or CSS custom properties, if the project has them; else ask). Rebuild the kit and the background after a change.

copy._doc: Copy rules for tools/check-copy.py. voiceFile: a style guide to read banned terms from at run time (for example "../VOICE.md", relative to the film folder); when it is null, bannedTerms applies. extraBanned: regexes for this film. allow: names to mask before checking (a product name that contains a banned word). spelling: us | uk | off. emDash: ban | allow.

scenes.beat: Hook and problem. Maya presents the plan, a raw draft in a clean browser window, then wonders: a question mark writes on. Frame 0 is the thumbnail.
The turn. The draft leaves as the agent window slides in with the prompt already there; published v1 and shared; zoom on the URL, accent circle, "one link". Maya walks over and points.

The client. Jordan holds a phone: invited sign-in, the one-time code steps to all six digits (zoom, "no account needed"), verified, opening, the page. Jordan asks in a speech bubble: "Can we start in May?"

Payoff. The open tab offers v2; click Refresh; the page is replaced by v2 (lift and land); zoom on the new kickoff date (the word May the viewer just read), accent circle; back out, then "same link" on the URL bar (a label written during a zoom lands off screen).
End card, flat: the Tidewell text wordmark, "Pages your clients can open.", a plain accent pill "Try Tidewell", tidewell.example.

captions.text: Her agent publishes and shares it.
Jordan opens it with a one-time code.
